title: Operator-Guided Model Reduction for Generative Sampling in Lattice Field Theory
abstract: arXiv:2605.11199v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural generative samplers for lattice field theory can be costly to train and evaluate. When they miss modes or assign them incorrect relative weights, biased observables do not reveal which collective variables are responsible. We project a trained flow-matching velocity onto vector fields built from lattice operators and Fourier modes. In two-dimensional lattice $\phi^4$ theory, the projection separates changes in the overall magnetization from the lowest nonzero-momentum fluctuations and guides an explicit invertible proposal that treats them separately. Allowing the amplitude of the lowest nonzero-momentum fluctuations to depend on the magnetization improves the overlap between the proposal and target distributions, while the same two-parameter modification at higher momenta gives smaller improvements. translated_title: 算子引导的格点场论生成式采样模型约简
translated_abstract: 格点场论中的神经生成式采样器在训练和评估上成本可能很高。当这类采样器遗漏某些模式或赋予它们错误的相对权重时，有偏差的观测量无法揭示究竟是哪些集体变量出了问题。我们将训练好的流匹配速度场投影到由格点算子和傅里叶模式构建的向量场上。在二维格点 φ⁴ 理论中，该投影将整体磁化强度的变化与最低非零动量涨落分离开来，并指导构建一个显式的可逆提议分布来分别处理二者。允许最低非零动量涨落的振幅依赖于磁化强度，可以改善提议分布与目标分布之间的重叠度，而在更高动量处施加相同的双参数修改则只能带来较小的改进。Metropolis–Hastings 修正定义了一个以目标玻尔兹曼分布为平稳分布的马尔可夫链。
tldr: 该论文提出将训练好的流匹配速度场投影到由格点算子和傅里叶模式构成的向量场上，以诊断并分离关键集体变量（磁化强度与最低非零动量涨落），据此构造显式可逆提议分布，并通过 Metropolis–Hastings 修正保证对目标玻尔兹曼分布的精确采样。
en_tdlr: This paper projects a trained flow-matching velocity onto vector fields built from lattice operators and Fourier modes to diagnose and disentangle key collective variables (magnetization and lowest nonzero-momentum fluctuations), constructs an explicit invertible proposal treating them separately, and uses Metropolis–Hastings correction to guarantee exact sampling from the target Boltzmann distribution.
